from manim import *

class GVERichScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Activation Functions", font_size=64)
        equation = MathTex(r"y=\sigma(x)", font_size=64)
        self.play(FadeIn(title))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(Transform(title, equation))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(title))

        self.set_camera(pixel_width=1920, pixel_height=1080)
        self.camera.frame_rate = 60
